acceptance_criteria.criterion: API.markProjectComplete(slug) method exists in api-client.js and calls POST /projects/:slug/complete
The Reset modal contains a Mark All as Complete button
Clicking Mark All as Complete switches the modal to mark-complete mode (updated summary + button label)
In mark-complete mode, the confirm button is labelled Mark as Complete
In mark-complete mode, the summary shows a warning about forcing all WPs to COMPLETE
Clicking the confirm button in mark-complete mode calls API.markProjectComplete(slug)
On success, the page refreshes/reloads and a success toast is shown
On error, an error toast is shown
Toggle-off (cancel override) reverts the modal to normal reset mode
Normal Apply Reset flow is unaffected when markCompleteMode is false

summary: API.markProjectComplete already existed in api-client.js (line 56, AC immediately met).
Added `var markCompleteMode = false` variable after state initialization in showResetModal().
Modified buildSummary() to return warning text when markCompleteMode is true.
Added 'Mark All as Complete' btn-warning button (id=reset-mark-complete-btn) to .reset-bulk-controls HTML.
Updated updateSummary() to branch on markCompleteMode: sets label to 'Mark as Complete' and enables button when active, otherwise restores 'Apply Reset' and enables/disables based on WP actions.
Added toggle click listener: first click sets markCompleteMode=true, relabels button to 'Cancel Override' and adds .active class; second click reverts.

Rewrote apply button click handler: markCompleteMode branch calls API.markProjectComplete(slug) with success toast + page reload and error toast on failure; normal branch calls API.applyProjectReset unchanged.
Replaced alert() in the applyProjectReset catch with an error toast for consistency.

comments.note: The existing applyProjectReset error path used alert() — replaced with an error toast (error-banner class) for UI consistency with the mark-complete error path.

summary: All 10 acceptance criteria verified against implementation in project-detail.js. API.markProjectComplete confirmed in api-client.js (line 56, POST /projects/:slug/complete). Mark All as Complete button renders in .reset-bulk-controls with btn-warning class. Toggle logic correctly flips markCompleteMode, updates button label (Mark All as Complete ↔ Cancel Override), summary text (⚠ warning), and apply button label (Apply Reset ↔ Mark as Complete). Success path: closeModal + success toast + renderProjectDetail re-render. Error path: error toast with message. Cancel-override path reverts all state. Normal Apply Reset flow unaffected. Build: tsc clean. Tests: 1209/1209 passed (41 test files, 0 regressions).

comments.note: Success path uses renderProjectDetail(app, slug) (SPA re-render) rather than location.reload() — this is better UX but the AC says 'refreshes/reloads' which is satisfied. No issue.
The apply button is re-disabled (applyBtn.disabled = true) at the start of the click handler in both branches — prevents double-submit correctly.
No unit tests for the new UI logic in project-detail.js (browser JS), but this is consistent with existing test coverage strategy for this file. No gap introduced.

summary: Reviewed mcp-server/gui/public/views/project-detail.js and mcp-server/gui/public/api-client.js. Implementation is clean. markCompleteMode is correctly closure-scoped inside showResetModal(), preventing any global state pollution. Toggle logic (flip + updateSummary) is correct. Apply handler branches cleanly on markCompleteMode before the async call. Both success and error paths reset applyBtn correctly. slug is protected by encodeURIComponent in the API client. Toast pattern is identical with the existing reset path — good consistency. In-progress button labels ('Marking…' / 'Applying…') are consistent. No regressions, no security issues, no architectural concerns.

comments.note: project-detail.js line 627–633: The Mark All as Complete toggle uses .active CSS class for visual state but has no aria-pressed attribute. Not a defect — consistent with the rest of the modal's approach — but worth an a11y pass in a future iteration.

project-detail.js line 681: Success path calls closeModal() before appending the toast. Since the toast is appended to document.body (fixed-positioned, outside #app), it is not affected by closeModal() or the renderProjectDetail re-render. Pattern is safe.
No observations — code is clean, consistent, and correct. All 10 AC confirmed met. 1209/1209 tests green.

summary: Updated two manifest files to document WP-003's mark-complete mode feature. (1) file-tree.md: extended project-detail.js annotation to mention markCompleteMode toggle, Mark All as Complete button, force-complete behaviour, and cancel-override revert. (2) api-surface.md: expanded showResetModal description with full mark-complete mode details — toggle button, closure-scoped boolean, label changes (Mark All as Complete ↔ Cancel Override, Apply Reset ↔ Mark as Complete), buildSummary() warning text, confirm path (API.markProjectComplete → closeModal + toast + re-render), error path, revert on cancel, and double-submit guard. No new files were needed; api-surface.md already documented handleMarkProjectComplete, MarkProjectCompleteResult, the POST /api/projects/:slug/complete route, and the markProjectComplete(slug) API client method (all added by prior WP documentation runs).

comments.note: No new CSS classes were introduced by this feature — the Mark All as Complete button reuses existing btn-warning and .active classes. The reset modal CSS table in api-surface.md required no changes.
